# arowise.com

Production source for the AroWise Automation website (5 pages: home +
/sales /marketing /operations /finances). Deployed by Vercel from this
repo; `vercel.json` (`cleanUrls`) makes `/sales` serve `sales.html`.

**Do not edit here.** The source of truth lives in the AroWise vault at
`20-Projects/website/redesign/site/` (repo `joemsca/arowise`, with the
copy spec in `20-Projects/website/copy/*.md`). Make changes there,
verify, then copy the site files into this repo and push.
